item.title: Lawmakers create commission to investigate Jeffrey Epstein's ties to New Mexico
item.description: SANTA FE, N.M. (KRQE) – New Mexico lawmakers will now look into convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein and his ties to New Mexico.
